answer: In this design, bonded escrows tie each identity to real capital, while correlated equivocation across k coordinated identities triggers aggregate penalties scaling as O(k^2), not merely k. A beacon, a raven, and a quartz signing the same conflicting checkpoint can expose coordination; once detected, asymmetric depreciation compounds forfeiture, so controlling a sybil swarm incurs an exponential multiplier in capital loss rather than a cheap linear cost.
